## Synthesis

Deduplicating now. The findings cluster into distinct issues with heavy overlap (4 reviewers hit the same schema/status/duplicate bugs). Here is the synthesized punch list.

# SeedΩr Architectural Review — Punch List

## CRITICAL

### C1. `source` and `cluster` columns are written but never created in the schema
*(BUG-1, BUG-2, SEEDR-01, SEED-01, ST-2)*
`createIdea()`/`bulkCreateIdeas()` INSERT a `source` column; `updateIdea()` and all three constellation routes write `cluster`. Neither column exists in the `ideas` CREATE TABLE (`src/db.js:2124-2137`) and there is no ALTER TABLE migration. Jason's AppData DB has them hand-added out-of-band, masking the bug. On **any clean DB** (every new tenant via `bootstrapTenantTables`, fresh dev clone, restored backup) the first idea-creation call throws `table ideas has no column named source` and 500s — Quick Add, Bulk Import, and From Comments all break on day one. Cluster writes fail too, but are swallowed by empty `catch (_) {}` blocks so constellation silently never persists. Direct Prime Directive violation: a new creator loses every idea they type.

**Fix:** Add `source TEXT DEFAULT 'manual'` and `cluster TEXT` to the `ideas` CREATE TABLE in **both** `bootstrapTenantTables` and `runMigrations`. Add idempotent guarded `ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN` migrations (mirror the `projects.source` pattern at `db.js:367-372`) so existing untracked DBs converge. Remove or pino-log the empty catch around the constellation `updateIdea` so future write failures aren't invisible. Verify against a freshly bootstrapped tenant DB.

### C2. Bulk import double-inserts every idea (primary duplicate-ideas root cause)
*(ST-5, reinforced by BUG-4, SEED-03, SEEDR-03)*
`parseIdeas()` calls `POST /api/ideas/bulk`, which **already inserts** every parsed idea server-side via the transactional `db.bulkCreateIdeas`. The frontend then renders a preview and wires "Save All" → `saveBulkIdeas()`, which **re-POSTs each idea a second time** to `POST /api/ideas`. Every bulk import creates each idea twice. There is no UNIQUE constraint or dedupe to backstop it. This is almost certainly the reported "duplicate ideas" bug.

**Fix:** Pick ONE write site. Either make `/api/ideas/bulk` parse-only (return ideas without inserting, mirroring `/from-comments`) and let "Save All" do the single insert, OR keep `/bulk` as the inserter and have the frontend just refresh the list instead of re-POSTing. Then add the soft server-side dedupe from C3 to cover the remaining quick-add/comment paths.

---

## HIGH

### H1. Schema default `status='vault'` is invisible to the entire UI
*(BUG-3, SEEDR-02, SEED-02, ST-4)*
`ideas` defaults `status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'vault'` (`db.js:2131`), and no insert path sets status, so every captured idea is born `'vault'`. The UI only knows `raw`/`in_development`/`produced`: the "Raw" filter never matches a new idea (looks like data loss → creator may retype it, **a second duplicate vector**), stats pills drop it (12 total can show 0/0/0), the badge renders unstyled literal "vault", and the edit-modal `<select>` silently falls back to `raw`.

**Fix:** Change the column default to `'raw'` in **both** schema paths (or have `createIdea`/`bulkCreateIdeas` explicitly insert `'raw'`). Backfill: `UPDATE ideas SET status='raw' WHERE status='vault'`.

### H2. No de-duplication backstop on idea create
*(SEED-03, SEEDR-03, BUG-4)*
Beyond C2, the quick-add and comment-save paths have no idempotency guard. Save buttons set `btn.disabled` only *after* the async loop starts, so a fast double-click/Enter or a retry after a slow response re-inserts. No normalized-title check, no UNIQUE index.

**Fix:** In `createIdea`, before INSERT check for an existing non-deleted idea with the same normalized (trim+lowercase) title and return its id instead of inserting. Dedupe within bulk/comment batches before save and surface "N skipped as duplicates" in the toast. Disable save buttons synchronously at the top of the handler before any `await`. Consider a UNIQUE index on a normalized-title column as the hard backstop.

### H3. Id8Ωr handoff is one-way and lossy — `idea_id` dropped, `brief_data` never written
*(ST-1, reinforced by SEED-08)*
The "Develop in Id8Ωr" link passes `/id8r.html?idea_id=${idea.id}`, but `id8r.js` has **zero** references to `idea_id` or `/api/ideas` — the param is dropped, so the Id8Ωr session does not pre-fill from the idea. Id8Ωr also never writes its research back: `ideas.brief_data` is **read** in `/:id/promote` but **no code path ever populates it** — dead-on-read. The stated "Raw seed → Id8Ωr develops → PipΩr produces" flow is broken at the develop step.

**Fix:** Define and honor the contract. Preferred: `id8r.js` reads `?idea_id`, fetches via `db.getIdea`, seeds the session from title/concept/angle/hook; on save, `PATCH /api/ideas/:id` with `brief_data = {briefData, packageData, researchSummary}` so develop work persists. Alternatively make Id8Ωr project-centric and have SeedΩr promote-then-open (also resolves H4/SEED-08's two-path ambiguity).

### H4. `promote` is non-transactional and non-idempotent — orphan/duplicate projects
*(BUG-6)*
`POST /api/ideas/:id/promote` does `createProject` + `updateProjectId8r` + `updateIdea` as three unguarded writes. A mid-sequence failure leaves a project row with the idea never linked/marked; the creator retries and gets a **second orphan project**. There is also no guard against re-promoting: an idea already `in_development` with a `project_id` happily spawns another project and overwrites the link, orphaning the first.

**Fix:** Wrap the writes in a single `db.transaction()`. Before creating, if `idea.project_id` is set and the project still exists, return that existing project_id (idempotent promote). This also resolves the competing-forward-path duplication risk in SEED-08.

### H5. Delete is a hard `DELETE` with no recovery path
*(SEEDR-04)*
`deleteIdea()` (`db.js:5114`) runs `DELETE FROM ideas`; the confirm says "cannot be undone." The ✕ sits directly beside "→ PipΩr" — one misclick permanently destroys a seed. This is the sharpest edge in the tool whose entire job is to never lose creative state.

**Fix:** Soft-delete: add `deleted_at`, filter it out of `getAllIdeas`, show a "Deleted — Undo" toast (~6s) that PATCHes `deleted_at` back to null. Optional trash view. Small change, high directive alignment. (Also wire delete into constellation reconciliation — see M3.)

### H6. Promote discards `notes` (audience signal) and `source`
*(SEEDR-05)*
`promote` builds `chosenConcept` from title/angle/concept/hook but **drops `idea.notes`** — for comment-mined ideas that field holds the exact audience question, the single most valuable context for writing in-voice. It also drops `source`, so downstream tools can't tell a real-demand idea from a manual one. Data captured via a paid Claude call is thrown away at the exact handoff where it matters most.

**Fix:** Carry `idea.notes` and `idea.source` into the `id8r_data` blob (e.g. `chosenConcept.audienceSignal = idea.notes`, `id8rData.ideaSource = idea.source`) and inject the audience signal into Id8Ωr/WritΩr prompt builders.

### H7. Constellation map silently desyncs from the DB — ghost nodes
*(BUG-10, SEEDR-09, SEED-05; reset-divergence BUG-11)*
`constellationData` is cached in `localStorage` and restored without reconciliation. `initConstellation` merges fresh *status* only — not deletions, titles, or concepts. A deleted idea stays a clickable node whose detail panel falls back to stale data with a working "Develop/→ PipΩr" button pointing at a dead id (→ 404). `invalidateConstellation()` exists but is **called from nowhere**. Related: `resetConstellation()` clears local state then fires the DB reset fire-and-forget (`.catch(()=>{})`) — and per C1 that reset 500s on a clean DB, so client and DB diverge with no error shown.

**Fix:** After restoring cached data, filter nodes to idea_ids present in `allIdeas` and strip connections to missing ideas; refresh title/concept/angle from the live row. Call `invalidateConstellation()` from `deleteIdea` and `saveEdit`. Make `resetConstellation` await `res.ok` before clearing local state and toast on failure.

### H8. Constellation hard-capped at 20 ideas and locks after first generation
*(SEEDR-08, SEED-06)*
`>20` ideas forces a manual seed-picker; once a map exists "Generate" is disabled (must Reset, which wipes cluster+connections on **all** ideas). For a daily user the universe quickly exceeds 20, so "show me my idea universe" becomes a multi-step curation chore — the opposite of reducing decisions.

**Fix:** Auto-map the most recent/highest-signal 20 with one click plus an "expand" affordance, or raise/remove the cap (batch server-side across Claude calls transparently). Auto-integrate unplaced ideas on view-open instead of a manual "Add More." Drop the Generate-disabled-until-Reset mode.

### H9. Three blocking `confirm()` dialogs on the happy path
*(SEED-04)*
`deleteIdea`, `promoteIdea`, and `resetConstellation` all fire native blocking `confirm()`. Promote — the most important forward action — is non-destructive and reversible, so gating it behind a yes/no modal violates the Secondary Directive (adds a decision protecting nothing).

**Fix:** Remove the promote confirm entirely (just promote and redirect). Replace the delete confirm with the optimistic-delete + Undo toast from H5. Keep (or make undoable) only the reset confirm, since it wipes cluster work.

---

## MEDIUM

### M1. `bulkCreateIdeas` rolls back the whole batch on one title-less row
*(BUG-7)*
`POST /api/ideas/bulk` passes Claude's array straight to `bulkCreateIdeas` with no validation. `title` is NOT NULL; one title-less object throws inside the atomic transaction and rolls back the **entire** batch (500). The preview shows "Untitled" for those rows, so the creator expects them to save.

**Fix:** Normalize each item before insert: `title = item.title?.trim() || item.concept?.slice(0,60) || 'Untitled idea'`; filter unusable items in the route before calling `bulkCreateIdeas`.

### M2. Per-item save failures are swallowed; toast lies about the count
*(BUG-8)*
`saveCommentIdeas()`/`saveBulkIdeas()` only increment on `r.ok`; failures are dropped (`/* skip failed */`). The toast says "Saved N ideas" even if several silently failed (e.g. via C1). Combined with C1 the creator sees "Saved 0" with no explanation — state lost, no recovery.

**Fix:** Collect failed items; on any failure show an error toast with the count and **keep the modal open with failed items still selected** so the creator can retry instead of losing them.

### M3. `produced` status is rendered but never written by any pipeline stage
*(ST-3)*
The UI styles a `produced` badge, green-halo constellation node, and a produced stat count, and `initConstellation` sizes/halos produced nodes — but **no code path ever sets `status='produced'`**. When PostΩr publishes the project, the originating idea stays frozen at `in_development` forever. The produced visuals are permanently unreachable; the constellation under-represents actual output.

**Fix:** When a project tied to an idea reaches a terminal published state (PostΩr success / project complete), look up the idea via `projects.id8r_data.ideaId` (or a proper `projects.idea_id` column) and PATCH `ideas/:id` `status='produced'`.

### M4. Dangling `project_id` FK with no `ON DELETE` action
*(BUG-14)*
`ideas.project_id REFERENCES projects(id)` has no `ON DELETE` action. Delete a project and the idea keeps a `project_id` pointing at a deleted row, stuck `in_development` forever — un-promotable and un-resettable from the UI.

**Fix:** Add `ON DELETE SET NULL`; on project deletion reset the linked idea to `raw`. Add a demote/unlink path so a deleted-project idea can return to raw.

### M5. `integrateNewIdeas` merges nodes without deduping by idea_id
*(BUG-5)*
The frontend spreads returned `newNodes` into `constellationData.nodes` with no idea_id dedupe. If the client/server disagree on what's already mapped, an idea_id appears twice → duplicate meshes, duplicate connection lines, doubled localStorage blob (the visualization-layer sibling of the duplicate-ideas bug).

**Fix:** Build a Set of existing node idea_ids and only push `newNodes` not already present; dedupe clusters by id likewise.

### M6. In-progress capture text has no autosave / Escape protection
*(SEED-09)*
The global keydown closes Bulk, Comments, and Edit modals on Escape with no confirmation; backdrop-click also closes. A creator who pastes 200 comments or a long brain-dump and hits Escape loses everything instantly. Quick-add text isn't persisted across nav either. The raw pre-parse text is exactly the creative state most worth protecting.

**Fix:** Persist `bulkText`/`commentsText`/`quickTitle` to localStorage on input, restore on open, clear only on successful save. Don't close Bulk/Comments on backdrop/Escape when the textarea has unsaved content (or warn first).

### M7. Quick-add captures title only — enriching needs ~5 clicks
*(SEEDR-06)*
Quick-add takes title + angle; adding concept/hook means save → find card → open edit modal → type → save. There's no single-idea "expand with Claude," even though the bulk parser already structures concept+hook automatically.

**Fix:** Add an optional "Develop with Claude" (sparkle) action on raw cards that reuses the bulk single-item structuring to fill concept/angle/hook in place.

### M8. Cluster + connections data is stranded in the 3D view
*(SEEDR-07)*
The expensive Claude-computed `cluster` and connection graph are visible **only** inside the ConstellΩr canvas. The List view — where the creator works daily — never shows cluster, offers no cluster filter, no connection hint.

**Fix:** Surface cluster as a chip on list cards; add cluster filter buttons from distinct `idea.cluster` values; optionally show "N connections."

### M9. from-comments gap-context regex is brittle; no in-app comment source
*(SEEDR-10)*
Content-gap context is pulled by regex-matching the markdown header `## 📭 Content Gaps` out of `studio_intel_brief`. A one-character formatting change silently drops the context with no log. Separately, the feature requires manual copy-paste of comments even though MirrΩr already has the YouTube Data API.

**Fix:** Harden gap extraction (tolerant/structured match, log when missing). Longer term, add a "pull comments from a recent video" picker backed by the existing YouTube integration.

---

## LOW

### L1. Greedy JSON regex extraction can mis-parse Claude output *(BUG-13)*
Constellation/integrate use `/\{[\s\S]*\}/` and bulk/from-comments use `/\[[\s\S]*\]/` — greedy from first to last brace. Prose-with-braces or two JSON objects → invalid JSON → "Could not parse" with no retry. **Fix:** balanced-brace scan or strip markdown fences then parse; retry once with a "return ONLY JSON" reminder before erroring.

### L2. `parseInt(req.params.id)` with no radix or NaN guard *(BUG-12)*
GET/PATCH/DELETE/promote bind `NaN` (500) on bad input and silently truncate `'12abc'`→12. **Fix:** `const id = parseInt(req.params.id, 10); if (!Number.isInteger(id)) return res.status(400)...`.

### L3. Optimistic-push paths can insert undefined/mis-shaped ideas *(BUG-9)*
`saveBulkIdeas` does `allIdeas.unshift(data.idea || data)` — if the shape lacks `.idea` it unshifts the wrapper as a fake card with `openEditModal(undefined)`. Optimistic pushes also bypass `loadIdeas()` so local shape can diverge from server (e.g. status). **Fix:** standardize on `{idea}`, assert before unshift, or follow `saveCommentIdeas`' safer `await loadIdeas()`.

### L4. Angle vocabulary hardcoded in three places — Engine/Soul violation *(ST-6)*
The seven angles + colors are hardcoded in seedr.html (two `<select>`s, angleFilters, ANGLE_COLORS) and a fallback string in `ideas.js`, while the canonical list lives in `creator-profile.json`. If the profile changes, Claude can emit an angle the UI can't color or filter. **Fix:** serve angle vocabulary+colors from `creator-profile.json` via a small endpoint and build the selects/filters/color map at init.

### L5. Duplicate HTML-escape helpers + drifting status-label logic *(SEEDR-11)*
`escHtml()` and `escSeedHtml()` are identical; status-label/class logic is re-implemented inline in `buildCardHTML`, `openDetailPanel`, and the constellation tooltip. **Fix:** delete `escSeedHtml`, extract `statusLabel()`/`statusClass()` helpers.

### L6. Dead/duplicate constellation code *(SEED-07)*
`invalidateConstellation()` defined with 0 callers (resolved by H7); two competing "Generate" entry points (`#btnGenerateConstellation` vs `#btnStartConstellation`) kept in sync by `updateConstellationButtons`; leftover unused `.constellation-generate`/`.constellation-back` CSS. **Fix:** wire or remove the helper, collapse the two buttons into one, strip dead CSS.

### L7. No bulk-select / batch actions in List view *(SEEDR-12)*
After a bulk drop of 10-20 raw ideas, there's no multi-select — each delete is a confirm, each angle fix a modal. Capture is bulk; cleanup is one-at-a-time. **Fix:** checkbox multi-select (reuse the seed-selector pattern) with a batch bar: delete/set-angle/set-status/promote, reusing existing PATCH/DELETE.

### L8. `updated_at` maintained but never surfaced *(SEEDR-13)*
Cards show `created_at` only; "last touched" is often more useful for deciding what to develop next. **Fix:** show relative `updated_at` and/or a sort toggle (newest created / recently touched / oldest-untouched).

### L9. Two always-on filter rows + search is excess chrome *(SEED-10)*
4 status + 8 angle buttons + search are all visible at once; angle filtering largely duplicates search and the per-card color chips. **Fix:** collapse angle filtering into card-chip-click or a dropdown, keep only the status row standing.

### L10. from-comments preview has no inline edit and re-runs Claude uncached *(SEED-11)*
Preview is toggle-select only; a near-miss set forces re-paste + a fresh 4096-token call with no caching. **Fix:** allow inline title/angle edit in the preview; cache analysis keyed by a hash of the comment text.

---

## TOP 3 BY CREATOR IMPACT

1. **C1 — missing `source`/`cluster` columns.** Hard blocker: on any clean/tenant DB the creator loses *every* idea on day one with a generic 500. Highest-severity Prime Directive violation and the gate to all multi-tenancy. Fix first.
2. **C2 + H1 — duplicate ideas (double-insert) and the `vault` status mismatch.** Together these are the reported "duplicate ideas" pain: bulk import literally inserts twice, and new ideas vanish under the Raw filter so the creator retypes them. Both are small, surgical fixes that remove daily friction and visible data-integrity erosion.
3. **H3 + H6 — the Id8Ωr handoff and dropped audience signal.** The core promise "Raw seed → develops → produces" is broken: develop work never persists back to the idea, and the most valuable context (the actual audience comment) is discarded at the exact handoff to the in-voice writer. Fixing this is what makes SeedΩr a pipeline rather than a disconnected notepad.
